description: Comptage routier - Historique - Données trafic issues des capteurs permanents is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direction de la Voirie et des Déplacements - Ville de Paris. Historical road traffic data from permanent sensorsfrom 2010 to year A-1. This dataset corresponds to the current year's history Road counting - Traffic data from permanent sensors On the Paris network, the majority of traffic is measured using electromagnetic loops located in the roadway. Coverage: Direction de la Voirie et des Déplacements - Ville de Paris. The portal shows the English title as "Tielaskenta - Historia - Liikennetiedot pysyvistä antureista" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Direction de la Voirie et des Déplacements - Ville de Paris. Its keywords include transport, circulation, mobilite, comptage-routier, dvd, voiture. The listing shows 6 download or service links in ZIP, PDF. The listing shows 2026-02-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
